original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Scoped proof that diag([i],[w],[w^-1 i w],1,...,1) in F2[SL2(F3)] needs exactly five paid rank-one calls for every finite number of restored dirty roles, including arbitrary free constant binary mixing.
scope_change_reason: Answer Open next question 1 in Wentao Li #4083 with an all-role proof, extending Cinna Davis #2010 and the first-order method of Sagar Thakrar #4032. The original card requests a changed nonabelian interface; this result closes a formal workspace route without claiming a native conversion.
bottleneck_link: Eliminates arbitrary restored dirty workspace as a way to reduce the five-call bill of this explicit nonabelian target. A different endpoint or operation contract is required before native pricing is useful.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved all-role lower bound and bounded exact corroboration. Do not run predecessor censuses or expand to different endpoints.
evidence: PROOF.md gives independent 2-call quaternion and 3-call order-three floors for every finite role count. verify.py checks the cocycle, the one/two-call quotient classification, sampled full-algebra telescoping, regular-action endpoints and eleven controls.
